headline: SPACEX'S ENDEAVOUR SPLASHES DOWN IN PACIFIC OCEAN, RETURNING EXPEDITION 74 ASTRONAUTS TO EARTH
summary: The Expedition 74 trio, consisting of astronauts, has returned to Earth. They splashed down in the Pacific Ocean after completing their mission on the International Space Station. The SpaceX Dragon spacecraft, known as the 'Endeavour', carried the astronauts, including American astronauts Mike Fincke, back to Earth. The spacecraft landed off the coast of San Diego, California. The astronauts were part of Expedition 74/75, which included a long-duration mission on the ISS.
